subject: Invoice origin handoff: portal API vs email copy + VAT tagging
messages:
From: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@macrosoft.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: MacroSoft AP <ap@macrosoft.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding — where invoice will originate and VAT tagging

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. MacroSoft is getting our AP team set up to receive invoices from Redwood. A few clarifying items so we can finish our vendor onboarding form:  

1) Who will create the invoice PDF in production — Redwood or MacroSoft? Do you send a PDF via email, or will you push through a portal/API?
2) If Redwood is the originator, can you include our VAT ID and the e-invoicing tags in the invoice metadata (we need fields for VAT, remit-to, and PO matching)?
3) We prefer receiving an API push to our portal (JSON payload + PDF) but will accept email copies for the first 2 months while we test. If you must email, please CC ap@macrosoft.com and include the PO number in subject line.

Attached is our vendor setup checklist and sample invoice schema. Let me know the easiest path for you and any sample payloads.

Thanks,
Sophie
Sophie Tran
Procurement Operations — MacroSoft
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@macrosoft.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Mar 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — where invoice will originate and VAT tagging

Hi Sophie — great questions, thanks. Short answer: we can support either flow, and we'd recommend portal/API push as the long-term approach. Details and next steps below.

High-level options:
- Portal/API push (recommended): Redwood generates invoice JSON + PDF and POSTs to your invoice endpoint. Payload supports VAT fields, PO, remit-to and a custom metadata block for internal tags.
- Email PDF copy (transitional): Redwood sends a signed PDF to ap@macrosoft.com and optionally to a second billing contact. Email copies include the PO in the subject and embed a machine-readable JSON invoice as an attachment if you ask.

Two minor constraints:
- For the portal push we need a target endpoint and basic auth or a token. We support mutual TLS if you require it.
- If you want the PDF to carry EU VAT reverse-charge markup, tell us which line-level tag you need; otherwise we include total VAT and a VAT ID field.

Attached: a sample PDF (sample-invoice-202803.pdf) and a CSV mapping example. If you can share a sandbox endpoint, Connor can run a small push tomorrow.

Next steps / asks:
1) Which path do you prefer for go-live (portal push or email copies for 60-days)?
2) Sandbox endpoint + auth method OR confirm email recipient list + PO subject convention.
3) Any required invoice numbering scheme (we default to RDW-{account}-{seq}).

Thanks — I’ll loop in Connor for the API test.

Best,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Finance Operations Lead — Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@macrosoft.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Mar 2028 14:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — where invoice will originate and VAT tagging

Hi Sophie — quick technical note from my side as we prep the sandbox test.

Portal/API push details (what I'll need to run a dry run):
- Endpoint: POST https://invoices.macrosoft.com/webhooks/redwood/sandbox
- Auth: Bearer token (please create a long-lived token for redwood-sandbox and paste into a secure note), or we can use basic auth (username/password).
- Payload: JSON with these top-level fields: invoice_number, date, account_id, lines (array), vat_total, vat_id, remit_to (object), po_number, attachments (array with base64 references). We will also attach a PDF.

If MacroSoft prefers email copies for validation window:
- We'll send to ap@macrosoft.com and copy a second address. Subject format: [PO {po_number}] Redwood Invoice {invoice_number} — please confirm.

Kimberly — can you confirm the SLA for storing copies in our billing console? Sophie — do you have a sandbox endpoint and a token you can share? If not, we can do email copies for two billing cycles while MacroSoft creates the endpoint.

Connor O'Brien
Payments Integrations — Redwood Inference
(attachment: invoice-mapping-example.csv)
From: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@macrosoft.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: MacroSoft AP <ap@macrosoft.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Apr 2028 15:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — where invoice will originate and VAT tagging

Hi Naomi, Connor — thanks for the clear options and the sample files. We will:  

- Start with email copies for April and May while our infra team stands up the sandbox endpoint. Please send to ap@macrosoft.com and copy procurement@macrosoft.com.
- Subject convention: [PO 2028-321] Redwood Invoice {invoice_number} — include PO in square brackets at the start.
- VAT: please include line-level VAT where applicable and include our VAT ID (GB999999973) in the VAT_ID field. Reverse-charge items will be flagged with tag "RC:yes" in metadata.
- Invoice numbering: we are fine with your RDW-MacroSoft-{seq} default.

Action items for Redwood:
- Start sending email PDF copies (include the embedded JSON invoice attachment) to ap@macrosoft.com + procurement@macrosoft.com for April invoices.
- Share the test payload you mentioned so our infra team can mirror it when they stand up the endpoint.

I'll confirm with our infra team on the sandbox token by EOD Friday. Thanks — Sophie
Sophie Tran
Procurement Operations — MacroSoft
(attachment: vendor-setup-checklist.pdf)
